$schema-note: Canonical cross-agent MCP registry. Single source of truth; per-agent native configs are generated from this by setup-mcp.ps1 / setup-mcp.sh, or by any agent following mcp/FORMATS.md. Placeholders: ${HOME} = user home on target machine. Tokens: ${GITHUB_MCP_PAT}, ${BAIDU_PAN_MCP_TOKEN} must be filled locally, NEVER committed.

lark-mcp.notes: Feishu/Lark MCP. Requires lark-mcp installed + credentials.env next to the start script.

huggingface.notes: Official HF MCP endpoint, no auth needed for read-only.

baidu-pan.notes: Baidu Netdisk MCP. Token from Baidu Pan MCP console.

github.notes: GitHub Copilot MCP. Disabled by default on source machine - gh CLI is preferred there. Enable per agent as needed.

ai-memory.notes: Local ai-memory service (also wired via hooks on ZCode/Codex). Only works where ai-memory.exe is installed.

microsoft-office.notes: Office MCP from microsoft/semanticworkbench. Requires uv.
